mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (student_id, class_id, enroll_date, tuition_amount, status, attended_count, absent_count, total_paid) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{enrollDate}, #{tuitionAmount}, #{status}, #{attendedCount}, #{absentCount}, #{totalPaid})
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollment SET student_id = #{studentId}, class_id = #{classId}, enroll_date = #{enrollDate}, tuition_amount = #{tuitionAmount}, status = #{status}, attended_count = #{attendedCount}, absent_count = #{absentCount}, total_paid = #{totalPaid} WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
UPDATE enrollment SET status = #{status} WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = '在读'
SELECT * FROM enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND class_id = #{classId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM enrollment WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND status = '在读'
